'''Glasspoint''' was a large, [[Basalt/Legends|basaltic]] column on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Giaca]], which served as a neutral meeting point for criminals and other factions. The column had a [[Color/Legends|black]], [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like appearance, and it was one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] in width and half a kilometer in height.<ref name="TUR" />
